title: HKGAI-V1: Towards Regional Sovereign Large Language Model for Hong Kong
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable as the paper does not measure aspects of faith/religion. The benchmarks focused on regional value alignment, knowledge of Hong Kong-specific topics, legal safety, and handling of culturally and politically sensitive queries.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
